title: Saved filter file
description: A named filter saved as YAML in the repository (D-056, SR-070): a `*.yaml` file directly in the `filters` folder of the workspace file. The same condition language is the `where` of every command that takes a selection, so a saved filter gives the same elements in app, CLI, API and MCP (SR-070 AK3). Element references may take any form (`resolveRef`); `filter.save` writes UUIDs.

description.description: What the filter is for, for people.

view.description: Elements that apply in this view; also the view of its `verification` conditions without `variant`.

sort.description: Order of `element.list` when its input gives no `sort`.

name.description: Name of a saved filter, unique in the workspace ignoring case (spec question ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#363); used to call it (`selection.filter`). Saving under an existing name replaces that filter.

condition.description: Combinable condition (SR-069). Exactly one operator per object. `all`: every condition holds (`[]` holds), `any`: some holds (`[]` does not), `not`: it does not hold.

all.title: All of
all.description: Conditions that must all hold; `[]` holds.

any.title: Any of
any.description: Conditions of which at least one must hold; `[]` does not.

type.title: Types
type.description: Type keys; an element of a subtype matches too unless `subtypes` is false.

subtypes.title: With subtypes
subtypes.description: Include subtypes of the type. Absent means true.

status.title: Statuses
status.description: Status keys as written in the files.

validFor.title: Valid for
validFor.description: Elements that apply in this view by their validity only, not the view: replacements and exclusions do not count.

verification.title: Verification status
verification.description: Verification status in `variant`, else in the view of the selection, else in the core.

variant.title: Variant
variant.description: View the verification status is computed in. Absent: the view of the selection, else the core.

validation.title: Validation status
validation.description: Needs always (open without record), requirements only with a validation record, no other element (SR-038 AK5).

emergent.title: Emergent
emergent.description: true: the property with the meaning `emergent` is `yes`; false: it is not.

source.title: Source
source.description: Value of the property with meaning `source` of imported elements.

text.title: Text search
text.description: Elements that element.search finds for this query in all fields (SR-068, SR-220 AK6): every word in the title, text, a property value, the type or status name, or an ID, typo tolerant, in any case, also as a word start, and, exact with 4+ letters and no digit, inside words (SR-221), quoted words as a phrase (SR-068 AK4), a designation through its element's other ones (SR-220), criterion keys and references. A query without a word matches none.

conditionStub.description: Only in MCP tools other than `element_search`, never in a saved filter file: a filter condition (`condition`); its grammar is in the input schema of `element_search`, under `selection.where`.

propertyCondition.description: Condition on the values of any property: none when it is absent, `null` or `[]`, else the items of a list or the one value. `exists`: some value, `missing`: none (both without `value`). `eq`: some value equals `value` (1 is not "1"), `ne`: not `eq`, `in`: some value equals an item of the list `value`. `contains`: some text contains `value`, ignoring case. `lt`, `le`, `gt`, `ge`: numbers with numbers, texts with texts by code units (ISO dates compare as dates). `matches`: some text matches the JavaScript regular expression `value` (flag u). A choice may be given by its display name. A key that holds relations takes element references, with `eq`, `ne`, `in`, `exists` and `missing` only.

op.title: Comparison
op.description: The comparison, as the condition describes it.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value to compare with; a list for `in`; none for `exists` and `missing`.

relationCondition.description: Condition on relations, e.g. without child: {relation: {meaning: derivation, direction: down}, exists: false} (SR-069 AK3). Evidence is a relation direction too. `exists: true` without `to` counts a relation also when its target is not available; with `to`, only an available other end that meets it.

kind.title: Relation kind
kind.description: A relation kind or a property of kind relation (validity, packages); with `meaning`, the kind must have it.

meaning.title: Meaning
meaning.description: Every relation kind with this meaning. Neither `kind` nor `meaning`: every relation kind.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: `up` = outgoing (to parents), `down` = incoming (from children), `evidence` = verification records pointing at the element in the view of the selection, else in the core (a record without variant holds for the core, and for every variant when the element's repository is marked `variant-independent`, SR-173; one with a variant for that variant), of any version and result; validation records do not count (D-007); no `kind`, `meaning` or `to`. Absent: up or down.

to.title: To
to.description: Condition the other end must meet.

exists.title: Exists
exists.description: `true`: the element has such a relation. `false`: it has none.

sortKey.description: A sort key (SR-075); no order is stored in element files.

by.title: Sort by
by.description: `id`: short ID. `identifier`: the property with the meaning `identifier`, digit runs by number (SR-9 before SR-10), else short ID after; `desc` reverses both. `type`, `status`: metamodel order. `title`: the title property. `verification`: verification status in the selection's view (else core): failed, open, outdated, verified (`indirect` too). `versionDate`: version time; uncommitted is newest. `hierarchy`: the derivation tree, ascending only. Else a property key the metamodel or an element has (no relations), by its first value: choices in metamodel order, then numbers, texts (ignoring case), booleans; no value last in both orders.
